scenes.prompt: Hanuman ji in a calm blessing pose beside Shani dev in a temple painting style, oil lamps and blue flowers, devotional light, the deity's face large, sharp and clearly visible in the upper half of the picture

scenes.prompt: Divine darshan of Shani dev, a calm Hindu deity with a dark blue-black complexion, a golden crown, dark blue robes, holding a bow and arrow, seated on a crow vahan, a calm just gaze, a dark temple sanctum with oil lamps, the deity's face large, sharp and clearly visible in the upper half of the picture
scenes.animate: a very slow push-in, the oil lamps flicker and smoke drifts, the face stays still
scenes.tts: शनि देव न्याय के देवता हैं। अच्छे कर्म, अच्छा फल।
scenes.sub: Shani dev nyaay ke devta hain. Achchhe karm, achchha phal.

scenes.prompt: A clay diya with mustard oil glowing under a huge old peepal tree on a Saturday evening, black sesame seeds and blue flowers offered, a small Shani shrine nearby, twilight
scenes.animate: the diya flame flickers and the peepal leaves sway gently
scenes.tts: शनिवार की शाम, पीपल के नीचे एक दीपक जलाइए।
